final: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, a.translink, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS x ON x.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = x.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind, a.translink), pair_shares AS (SELECT trader_type, translink, record_count, CAST(record_count AS REAL) / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY trader_type) AS share FROM pair_counts), type_averages AS (SELECT trader_type, AVG(share) AS average_share FROM pair_shares GROUP BY trader_type) SELECT p.trader_type, AVG(p.record_count) AS average_record_count, AVG(p.share) AS average_share, AVG(p.share - a.average_share) AS average_share_excess FROM pair_shares AS p JOIN type_averages AS a ON a.trader_type = p.trader_type WHERE p.share > a.average_share GROUP BY p.trader_type
